fontHelp: UI is used for text, controls, and the clock. Mono is used for keyboard shortcuts. Custom fonts must be installed on this device.
overrideHelp: Default follows your global font. Missing fonts use the default.
privacy: Saved in your browser profile. No tracking, no accounts.
storageError: Storage is unavailable. Changes will last until this tab closes.
syncError: Saved on this device, but not synced to your other devices yet.
searchError: Search is unavailable. Try your browser’s address bar.
settingsError: Customize could not load. Reload this tab to try again.
languageError: This translation could not load. Using English for now.
typeToSearchHelp: Typing on this page goes straight to the search field. When this is off, press / first.
serviceIconsHelp: Uses site icons already saved in your browser, in the search field and for pinned sites. Nothing is downloaded. Turning this on asks for permission to read them.
showPinnedSitesHelp: Up to 8 shortcuts below the clock and date. Hiding them keeps your list.
pinnedSitesFull: 8 sites is the limit. Remove one to add another.
siteAddressError: Enter a website address, such as example.com.
siteSizeError: Your pinned sites would be too large to sync. Use a shorter address or name.
